title: Polyhomogeneous mapping properties of the Radon transform and backprojection operator on the unit ball
summary: This article covers polyhomogeneous mapping properties of the Radon transform $R$ of smooth functions on the open unit ball $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ and the back-projection operator $R^*$ on $Z=(-1,1)\times S^{n-1}\subset\mathbb{R}\times S^{n-1}$. We construct a double $b$-fibration which desingularizes the point-hyperplane relation of $\overlineΩ$ as the total space of a fibration over $\overline{Z}$.
